svg.text: Agentic SDLC harness — how a requirement becomes a reviewed, traced draft PR
A mechanism, not a feature: agents run every stage; humans act only at the orange gates; agents never merge, approve, or un-draft a PR.
paths agents may / may not touch
Devin mode per stage, gate provider
clauses loaded at runtime and quoted
into each brief; a missing standard
2 · Orchestrator (harness/agentic_sdlc/orchestrator.py — state machine, persisted state.json, resumable)
bound: qa 2 · QA runs on a different Devin mode with its own independent oracle
bound: rca 2 · Evaluate sees the evidence package, never the repo
Every stage: prepare → execute → verify → deliver | verdicts: PASS · FAIL · BLOCKED · CONFIRMED · VIOLATION · REFUTED · NEEDS-HUMAN

Unknowns become stable-ID questions (Q-SPEC-1 …) answered by a human via `harness answer` — never guessed. Loops are bounded; at the bound the run pauses NEEDS-HUMAN and only a human can `harness extend`.
A gate pauses the run until a human decision is recorded (GitHub label/review or file provider); bot actors are rejected; before-merge enforces the reviewer count (2 on protected paths).
3 · One Devin child session per stage attempt (no shared memory between stages)
only the artifacts this stage may see
relay — parent session runs the child
mode per stage: Coding normal, QA ultra
4 · Deterministic verify after every Coding / Fix PASS (checks/)
only files named in the brief changed
agent/ branch · draft PR · AI-Governance trailer · no merge / approve
no silent `or 0` / default-to-zero on missing or late input
no control flow inside models / settings
no deleted guards or except blocks
FAIL → fed back into the Coding ⇄ QA loop automatically (no human). A false positive is fixed in the checker and logged as harness.corrected.
PR diff vs its base branch
5 · Outputs — every run leaves the same evidence set under runs/<run-id>/
in the target repo, test-first, with the
a human flips it to ready and merges
rebuilds state and proves the chain
PR → doc, keyed by spec ids; human

Humans only: answer questions · decide the gates · extend an escalated loop · waive a traced id · flip draft → ready · merge. Each is recorded with the actor in the audit log; an agent cannot do any of them.
